title: Concept: Redis error detail disclosed in a response
description: A Redis type mismatch error naming the key in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The error confirms the key naming scheme and that the store is Redis, so an attacker learns how sessions, counters and OTP attempts are keyed.
applicability: Deployments that render a Redis type mismatch error naming the key into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The error confirms the key naming scheme and that the store is Redis, so an attacker learns how sessions, counters and OTP attempts are keyed.
